prompt:

Header text verbatim: "hjälpsam". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "helpful".
Scene: A helpful shop assistant patiently guiding a shopper to the correct shelf.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "hjälpa → hjälpsam: help → helpful.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Personalen är mycket hjälpsam.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
